token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near its graduation, approaching BONDING_SUPPLY

pair_created_before_graduation.meaning: the (token,quote) UniSwapV2 pair has been created (deployable from token and quote addresses) before graduation

token_transfer_restricted_until_graduati.meaning: LaunchToken cannot be transferred until graduation and can only be moved by the launchpad and GTE router

graduation_completed.meaning: the graduation transaction completes: addLiquidity deposits 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting

graduation_reverted.meaning: the addLiquidity call fails and the whole graduation transaction reverts, disabling graduation permanently

claims.scope: LaunchToken graduation via _graduate/_createPairAndSwapRemaining adding liquidity to a UniSwapV2 (token,quote) pair

preconditions.text: A LaunchToken is near its graduation (approaching BONDING_SUPPLY).; The (token,quote) UniSwapV2 pair can be created by providing the LaunchToken address and quote address, and the attacker can deploy it before graduation.; LaunchToken cannot be transferred until graduation and can only be moved by the launchpad and the GTE router; _assertValidRecipient prevents the pair as final recipient.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: When a LaunchToken reaches BONDING_SUPPLY on a buy, graduation should complete by depositing 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The addLiquidity call fails, making the whole graduation transaction revert and disabling graduation permanently.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The pair is created before graduation by the attacker supplying the LaunchToken and quote addresses.
LaunchToken transfers are restricted until graduation; _assertValidRecipient prevents the pair as final recipient.
The graduation path is _graduate -> _createPairAndSwapRemaining -> uniV2Router.addLiquidity on the (token,quote) pair.

limitations: Permanence of the DoS depends on the asserted _assertValidRecipient restriction, which is not independently verified.
The 1 wei deposit/sync and reserveB==0 revert are root-cause mechanics, not encoded as P or as the selected impact.
Only the graduation_reverts_forever impact is formalized here; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
